text: The Patriots are suiting up in throwbacks this week as they prepare for an AFC home matchup against the 3-1 Raiders at Gillette Stadium, but the injury report has been a mixed bag heading into the contest—Rhamondre Stevenson returned to practice after dealing with an injury that had left the running back situation clouded, though cornerback Christian Gonzalez and safety Carlton Davis remain sidelined. Meanwhile, the front office made roster moves to shore up depth, signing safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and adding linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad, as Kirk Cousins' surprisingly hot start to the season gives Las Vegas momentum in what figures to be a crucial test for the Patriots' defense. The team also unveiled a new 15,000-square-foot JetBlue Loft at Gillette Stadium as premium hospitality space, giving fans something to admire while the 2-2 Patriots look to build on whatever momentum they can muster against one of the league's early surprises.
